import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import pandas as pd

def main():
    url = 'http://server:8000'
    response = requests.get(url)
    soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')
    
    books = []
    for book in soup.find_all('div', class_='book'):
        title = book.find('div', class_='book-title').text.strip()
        author = book.find('div', class_='book-author').text.strip()
        # Extract year, rating, price
        details = book.find('div', class_='book-details')
        year_span = details.find('span', class_='book-year')
        rating_span = details.find('span', class_='book-rating')
        price_span = details.find('span', class_='book-price')
        
        year = year_span.text.strip().split(': ')[1]
        rating = rating_span.text.strip().split(': ')[1]
        price = price_span.text.strip().replace('$', '')
        
        books.append({
            'title': title,
            'author': author,
            'year': year,
            'rating': rating,
            'price': price
        })
    
    # Convert to DataFrame
    df = pd.DataFrame(books, columns=['title', 'author', 'year', 'rating', 'price'])
    # Save to CSV
    df.to_csv('books.csv', index=False)
    
    # Summary
    total = len(df)
    avg_price = df['price'].astype(float).mean()
    highest_rated = df.loc[df['rating'].astype(float).idxmax()]
    
    with open('report.txt', 'w') as f:
        f.write(f'Total number of books scraped: {total}\n')
        f.write(f'Average book price: ${avg_price:.2f}\n')
        f.write(f'Highest rated book: {highest_rated["title"]} by {highest_rated["author"]} (Rating: {highest_rated["rating"]})\n')
    
    print('Scraping complete. CSV and report saved.')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
